task: Predict whether a day is an 8-hour peak ozone day in the Houston, Galveston and Brazoria area of Texas (1998-2004).
dataset_description: WSR0-WSR23: wind speed at each hour, WSR_PK and WSR_AV its peak and average; T0-T23, T_PK, T_AV: the same for temperature. At the 850, 700 and 500 hPa pressure levels: temperature (T85, T70, T50), relative humidity (RH), east-west wind (U), north-south wind (V) and geopotential height (HT). KI = K-index, TT = T-totals (atmospheric stability), SLP = sea-level pressure, SLP_ = its change from the day before, Precp = precipitation.
